policy: Discouraged fragments are checked only in localized user-facing fields, never in canonical source snapshots. A genuine method or standard identifier may remain Latin when it is clearer than an invented Russian substitute. Exceptions must be explicit and slug-scoped rather than silently weakening the global gate.

exceptions.reason: In a QA runbook, «чек-лист» is established professional terminology and is clearer to the target audience than an artificial replacement.
